title: Fix ledger bug in payment webhook
description: Fix unbalanced ledger entry where settlePayment passes totalAmount: 0n instead of order.totalAmount
completion: Fixed unbalanced ledger in payment webhook: removed per-payment settlePayment calls that passed totalAmount:0n; now calls postSaleToLedger once with order.totalAmount and all settled payments. Made actorUserId nullable in ledger functions to support webhook (no authenticated user) context.
